profile.name: PQSC量子系统控制器
profile.description: 苏黎世仪器的PQSC是一种量子系统控制器，用于在量子测控实验中统一产生和分发触发信号，通过ZSync协调多台已连接仪器，并检查参考时钟锁定与端口连接状态。
profile.description_en: The Zurich Instruments PQSC is a quantum system controller used in quantum measurement and control setups to generate and distribute triggers, coordinate multiple connected instruments over ZSync, and verify reference clock lock and port connectivity.
